module security.passwords
  purpose: Classify how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: The strength rating of a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

function has_letter(password: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether the password contains at least one letter.
  example: has_letter("1234!") is false
  example: has_letter("12a4") is true

  let found be for each character in password.characters any character.matches(raw "[A-Za-z]")
  return found
end

function has_digit(password: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether the password contains at least one digit.
  example: has_digit("abc!") is false
  example: has_digit("ab3") is true

  let found be for each character in password.characters any character.matches(raw "[0-9]")
  return found
end

function has_other(password: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether the password contains a character that is neither a letter nor a digit.
  example: has_other("abc123") is false
  example: has_other("abc 123") is true

  let found be for each character in password.characters any character.matches(raw "[^A-Za-z0-9]")
  return found
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong (12 or more characters with letters, digits and other characters), Fair (8 or more characters) or Weak.
  tags: security, passwords
  example: classify("abc") is Weak
  example: classify("abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify("Abcdefghijkl1") is Fair
  example: classify("Abcdef123!xyz") is Strong

  let size be password.length()
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter(password) and has_digit(password) and has_other(password) then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

test "a short password is weak"
  check classify("hunter2") is Weak
end

test "a long mixed password is strong"
  check classify("correct Horse 9 battery") is Strong
end

test "a long password without digits is only fair"
  check classify("correct horse battery!") is Fair
end

module security.passwords
  purpose: Rate how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: How hard a password is to guess, from Weak to Strong.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong (12 or more characters with a letter, a digit and another kind of character), Fair (8 or more characters) or Weak.
  tags: security, passwords
  example: classify("short") is Weak
  example: classify("abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify("abcdefghijkl12") is Fair
  example: classify("Abcdefghij1!") is Strong

  let size be password.length()
  let symbols be password.characters()
  let has_letter be for each symbol in symbols any symbol.matches(raw "[A-Za-z]")
  let has_digit be for each symbol in symbols any symbol.matches(raw "[0-9]")
  let has_other be for each symbol in symbols any not symbol.matches(raw "[A-Za-z0-9]")
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

test "a short password is weak"
  check classify("abc1!") is Weak
end

test "an eight character password is fair"
  check classify("abcd1234") is Fair
end

test "a long password without a symbol is only fair"
  check classify("abcdefghijkl12") is Fair
end

test "a long mixed password is strong"
  check classify("Abcdefghij1!") is Strong
end

module security.passwords
  purpose: Rate how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: How well a password resists guessing.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong (12+ characters with letters, digits and other characters), Fair (8+ characters) or Weak.
  tags: security, passwords
  example: classify(password: "Tr0ub4dor&3x") is Strong
  example: classify(password: "abcdefghijklmnop") is Fair
  example: classify(password: "Abcdefg1") is Fair
  example: classify(password: "short") is Weak
  example: classify(password: "") is Weak

  let size be password.length()
  let has_letter be password.matches(raw "^.*[A-Za-z].*$")
  let has_digit be password.matches(raw "^.*[0-9].*$")
  let has_other be password.matches(raw "^.*[^A-Za-z0-9].*$")
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end
